green.name: Crash dump files and VS Code installer residue

yellow.name: JianyingPro data
yellow.content_profile: Drafts, media cache, previews, and exports may coexist.
yellow.why_manual: Deleting the folder can remove drafts or locally stored media.
yellow.disposal: Use JianyingPro's cache-management controls first; then review completed exports and unused drafts in File Explorer.
yellow.risk: High risk of losing unfinished editing work.
yellow.open_note: Open only for review. Do not remove the entire folder manually.

yellow.name: WPS / Kingsoft data
yellow.content_profile: Documents, templates, cloud-sync data, and caches may coexist.
yellow.why_manual: The scanner cannot distinguish cached files from documents and account data.
yellow.disposal: Use WPS settings to clear cache, then review local backup and download folders in File Explorer.
yellow.risk: Removing folders directly may affect documents, templates, or signed-in account data.
yellow.open_note: Open only for review. Prefer WPS's own cleanup controls.

yellow.name: VS Code and Cursor profile data
yellow.content_profile: Extensions, settings, workspace storage, logs, and history.
yellow.why_manual: Removing all profile data resets editors and can remove extension state.
yellow.disposal: Use the editor's extension manager and Clear Workspace History; review old logs and extensions before removing them.
yellow.risk: May reset settings and remove local workspace state.

red.name: Installed applications
red.size: 至少约 31 GB（已扫描部分）
red.why_keep: Installed programs must be removed through Windows settings or their own uninstallers.
red.indirect_release: Open Settings > Apps > Installed apps, sort by size, and uninstall applications you no longer use such as unused emulators, developer tools, or games.
red.auto_reclaim: Do not delete program folders directly.

red.name: Docker and WSL data
red.why_keep: Container images, volumes, and Linux distributions may be active development data.
red.indirect_release: Use Docker Desktop's cleanup tools and `docker system prune` only after reviewing unused images and volumes; manage WSL distributions with its official commands.
red.auto_reclaim: Do not delete these folders in File Explorer.

summary.overview: The immediate pressure is Autodesk's 17.5 GB temporary installer cache; safe cache cleanup can release about 19.2 GB.
priority: Close Autodesk installer/update tools and move the ODIS download cache to Recycle Bin.
Clean npm/pip caches after package installation tasks finish.
Review JianyingPro and WPS from inside their own cleanup controls before removing any data.
long_term: Enable Settings > System > Storage > Storage Sense.
Use Disk Cleanup for Windows Update cleanup and temporary files; do not manually remove Windows component-store files.
Keep large project archives and finished media on D: or external storage when possible.
